title: Yennai Arindhaal
desc: Sathyadev, an honest police officer, is on a mission to stop an organ trafficking racket, unaware that the mastermind is the same person who killed his beloved.

title: Kunguma Chimizh
desc: Orphans Ravi and Philomena meet on a bus journey and fall in love, but poverty and unemployment create a barrier between them.

title: Puthu Paatu
desc: When a woman falls in love with her brother's personal manager, she believes their connection is genuine. However, when she discovers he's already in a relationship she is devastated.

title: Plus Two
desc: On learning about the death of Meenakshi's mother, Prince sympathises with her. Gradually, when his sympathy turns into love, he unearths some of her dark secrets.

title: Pattikattu Ponniah
desc: A farmer heads to the city to find a way to pay off his father's debts. However, things take an unexpected twist when he turns to wrestling as a profession.
